_comment: GCEARTH -- cloud-only test tenant. No Active Directory, no on-premises Exchange.
THIS FILE IS THE TEST. OnPremAD and OnPremExchange are false, and Directories
is empty, so every tool the capability scanner classifies as needing AD or
on-premises Exchange should be ABSENT from the console -- not greyed out.
Anything that still appears, or appears and then fails, is a finding: see
MicrosoftGraph is false to start with on purpose. Turn it on in Tenant Manager
once the Graph app registration is in place and the five Graph tools should
Copy to Config\Tenants\gcearth.json on the install under test.
